snippet.title: Chrono Hunter - Official Beta Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Take a look at the Beta Trailer for Chrono Hunter, a VR action melee shooter developed by INTOSTUDIO. Players will embody a time-space agent to dispatch enemies and explore diverse planets on a galaxy-wide journey with advanced gear at the ready. From guns to shields or swords, make use of unique abilities to use powerful skills derived from the energy of the universe. Chrono Hunter is coming soon to Meta Quest with a beta available now through the INTOSTUDIO Discord.
